working_tree_at_capture.$comment: Not the red — the same rule, same command, run over the working tree at the moment this artefact was written. It is recorded here rather than left out because the wave landed W2-W5's producers while the census was being taken, and an evidence file that only showed the red would be describing a tree that had already moved. This is the transition the rule exists to make visible; W6 takes the record run.
